730:t_1:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So that $$アサキム$$ guy... killed $$セツコ$$'s comrades...?」

730:t_1:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Yeah, that's right. Captain $$デンゼル$$ and Lieutenant $$トビー$$ of $$グローリー・スター$$ were killed by $$アサキム$$...」

730:t_1:6.en:
$$シン$$
「He knocked $$セツコ$$ down into despair just to awaken her $$スフィア$$.」

730:t_1:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Captain $$デンゼル$$ and Lieutenant $$トビー$$ we have now are the same people, from a parallel world.」

730:t_1:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even those two were only brought here by $$アサキム$$ at first, just to shake $$セツコ$$ up.」

730:t_1:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The more I hear, the more ruthless that guy turns out to be.」

730:t_1:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But the story I heard from $$ランド$$ gives a slightly different impression.」

730:t_1:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ランド$$ doesn't hate $$アサキム$$, after all. The main reason he fights him is that $$アサキム$$ is after the $$スフィア$$s.」

730:t_1:12.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I think it's because he's grateful that $$アサキム$$ helped $$メール$$, who got separated from everyone in the $$大時空震動$$.」

730:t_1:13.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Out of consideration for $$セツコ$$, he usually tries not to show that attitude, though.」

730:t_1:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「The more I hear, the less I understand $$アサキム$$.」

730:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So you mean he'll be good or evil, whatever it takes for his goal.」

730:t_1:17.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Weren't you listening, $$カグラ$$? He's collecting the $$スフィア$$s.」

730:t_1:18.en:
$$シン$$
「And to do that, he put $$セツコ$$ through hell, and he's after the lives of $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$... and $n.」

730:t_1:19.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I know that much myself. I want to know what he's trying to do once he gets those $$スフィア$$s.」

730:t_1:21.en:
$$ロラン$$
「After all, isn't it to defeat the $$御使い$$s...?」

730:t_1:22.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Probably. He also seems furious about the curse they put on him.」

730:t_1:24.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「In fairy tales, everyone longs for immortality, but in reality it seems to be different.」

730:t_1:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...I understand how he feels, a little...」

730:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If I became immortal, and $$ティファ$$ grew old and died before me, I could never stand it...」

730:t_1:30.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Even after the people dear to you are gone, you keep on living alone... I think that loneliness must be almost too painful to bear.」

730:t_1:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But you can't even take your own life... It would be like a torment that never ends.」

730:t_1:32.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ディアナ$$ said it too. That an eternity lived all alone has no meaning at all...」

730:t_1:33.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「So he's collecting the $$スフィア$$s to gain the power to take revenge on the $$御使い$$s...」

730:t_1:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He means to break their immortality with that power...」

730:t_1:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「But that would mean handing over the lives of $n and the others. I can't accept that.」

730:t_1:36.en:
$$シン$$
「Besides, I have no intention of forgiving what he's done...!」

730:t_1:37.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Me neither. No matter the reason, there are things you must never do.」

730:t_1:38.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But if he's willing to cooperate with us to defeat the $$御使い$$s...」

730:t_1:39.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Doesn't look like we can expect that.」

730:t_1:40.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll have to fight him after all, I guess.」

730:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「If we can just stop his movement, the system to seal him is ready.」

730:t_1:42.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If we end up fighting him, hesitation will be the death of us...」

730:t_1:43.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know. If he can turn evil for his goal, we have reasons we can't afford to lose, too.」

730:t_1:44.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It's almost time to descend into the atmosphere.」

730:t_1:45.en:
$$シン$$
「The fight with $$アサキム$$ that has gone on since the $$多元戦争$$... Is it finally going to be settled soon...」

730:t_1:47.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Have you sorted out your feelings, $$セツコ$$?」

730:t_1:49.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If we leave him alone, even more sorrow will spread.」

730:t_1:50.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I will fight $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, for myself and for the world.」

730:t_1:52.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... how do I put this... I racked my brain over a lot of stuff, such as it is...」

730:t_1:53.en:
$$ランド$$
「In the end, I just don't get it!」

730:t_1:55.en:
$$ランド$$
「Anyway, that's how it is, so I'll decide the rest after I meet him.」

730:t_1:56.en:
$$クロウ$$
「OK. If that's your answer, then that's fine.」

730:t_1:57.en:
$n
「We'll back you up too, so $$セツコ$$ and $$ランド$$, give it everything you've got.」

730:t_1:59.en:
$$ランド$$
「Speaking of which, you watch yourself too. That guy's after every Reactor, remember.」

730:t_1:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「No need to worry. We'll look after $n.」

730:t_1:61.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Then the Short Straw Alliance will back $$クロウ$$ up.」

730:t_1:62.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll protect $$セツコ$$, along with $$カミーユ$$ and the others.」

730:t_1:63.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then we shall take charge of keeping an eye on $$ランド$$.」

730:t_1:65.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This isn't a problem for the Reactors alone, after all.」

730:t_1:66.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's all unite as one and fight him.」

730:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Will sugar water do as a thank-you?」

730:t_1:74.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If that bastard takes you down, don't forget there are plenty of people who'll grieve.」

730:t_1:76.en:
$$トビー$$
「$$グローリー・スター$$ without its ace just doesn't hold together, you know.」

730:t_1:80.en:
$$エスター$$
「Let's win this for sure, $$クロウ$$!」

730:t_1:81.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I entrust you with His Highness's regrets.」
